method: Actual finite image-tool inspection of four native-original/current-reference spectral/F0 plots. No loudness, gain or PCM comparison.

observations.observation: ORIG/A1 whole-word relative spectra and local F0 peak/decline/last-onset shape closely match, unlike B references. Supports intended-side only at finite low confidence, not mechanical leave-one-out pass or guarantee of all four phones.

ORIG whole-word relative spectral transitions and mid-to-late peak then descent more resemble A references than B, but absolute F0 and initial tracking differ; weak whole-word supporting evidence only, not an independent syllable-by-syllable pass.

After unvoiced central interval, ORIG5.41..5.47s has low F0 slight rise similar to A1/A2; B1/B2 corresponding restarted voicing markedly higher. Supports A-side low, retain conflicting reverse spectral calibration unchanged.

Single original numbers figure lacks confusable controls; root does not infer numeral identities/tones solely from spectrogram or ASR. ACE window has one voiced nucleus followed by unvoiced portion, consistent with English-word handling rather than three isolated letters. No complete digit-tone pass inferred.

Actually viewed root focused single-character-context control plot: ORIG/A1/A2 relative spectral transition locations and low plateau/re-onset/decline F0 are very close, whereas single-target B controls shift transitions and later contour. Supports intended-side direct finite low for current 多 only. Original pending mechanical calibration remains pending; no guarantee of all name syllables or human listening.
